pattern: のが上手（のがじょうず）
keywords: Ms. Tanaka is good at listening to people.
My younger brother is good at cooking.
restrictions: For modest self-description, 得意 is often more suitable than praising yourself with 上手.
mistake: Keep が between the nominalized action and 上手.
